mechanism: Replace noisy historical mean returns with equilibrium implied returns Pi = delta * Sigma * w_mkt (reverse optimisation from a benchmark book), then tilt toward views Q on portfolios P with confidence Omega (diag of P tau Sigma P'), via the BL posterior mean. causal_rationale: Mean estimates are the dominant error source in MVO; anchoring to an equilibrium prior and admitting forecasts in proportion to their confidence stabilises weights.

weaknesses: Equal-weight w_mkt (not a real market portfolio); tau and delta arbitrary; views hand-typed.

pit_requirements: Sigma and view uncertainties from data before the solve.
hypothesis: Allocator solved on BL posterior means (prior = previous book) has lower weight turnover and equal or higher forward E[log W] than the same solve on raw posterior means.

falsifier: No turnover reduction or lower forward E[log W].

mechanism: Jitter the return panel with small noise, re-estimate inputs and re-optimise; if weights jump (MVO as 'error maximiser') the solution is fitting noise. A robust solve degrades smoothly under perturbation.
causal_rationale: Real structure survives small perturbations; noise-fit weights do not, and that is why in-sample optimal books fall off a cliff out of sample.
original_implementation: Adds N(0, 0.2-0.5%) noise to daily returns, re-solves, compares frontier and weights; 6-month in-sample / 6-month out-of-sample split.
weaknesses: Single perturbation draw; noise scale arbitrary.
mt5_translation: Report organ on the allocator: K perturbed re-solves (bootstrap blocks of sleeve returns or jittered posterior moments), publish per-sleeve weight dispersion and the L1 turnover between perturbed solves; flag sleeves whose weight sign or size is unstable.
pit_requirements: Perturb only the inputs the solve already used.
feature_representation: weight_dispersion per sleeve; book L1 instability.
hypothesis: Sleeves whose allocator weight has high perturbation dispersion realise lower forward E[log W] contribution than their solved weight implies.
leakage_risks: None if inputs are the solve's own.
falsifier: No relation between dispersion and forward contribution shortfall.
